results.note: Kata Noi bay seen from the rocks at its south end: turquoise water, the curving beach with the Katathani umbrellas and the wooded headland (geotagged, in the Kata Noi beach category). Both candidates were rejected. c1 is a generic sunset with a woman's silhouette and nothing that marks it as Kata Noi; it is also the places:kata-noi-beach candidate. c2 is a night portrait of a woman on a chair. This photo came from a Commons search.

Nai Harn Beach looking north to The Nai Harn hotel, terraced on the wooded hill; pale hazy sky (candidate 1, passed). A brighter blue-sky option if wanted: File:Nai harn beach phuket (63).jpg by Wolfgang Holzem, CC BY-SA 4.0.

Longtail boats moored off Rawai Beach under a clear sky, with the wooded headland behind (candidate 1, passed). Possible duplicate: this same file is also the first candidate for places:rawai-seafood-market. If that card uses it too, swap one of them.

View from the Big Buddha hill over Chalong town, the road down to Chalong Pier and the bay full of yachts; overcast (candidate 1, passed). The pier and bay are in the upper third, so a crop that sits higher (object-position around 30%) frames it better than a centred crop. Candidate 2 was almost only open water and sky.

Pastel Sino-Portuguese shophouses along Thalang Road in Old Phuket Town; cloudy sky, parked cars in front (candidate 1, passed). Candidate 2 (Thalang_Road_3.jpg) is also a candidate for places:sunday-walking-street, so leaving it out here avoids a duplicate.
Kathu Waterfall running over granite boulders in the jungle; sharp and already 16:9 (candidate 1, passed). Saved as .jpg.
Clear, shallow turquoise sea at Cape Panwa with a longtail boat and the offshore islands under a blue sky (candidate 1, passed; geotagged at the cape).

Panorama of the Ao Po pier shore (boats, beacon tower, wooded hills) under big white clouds; a Commons Quality Image (candidate 2). The photo is about 2.2:1, and a centred 16:9 crop keeps the pier. Candidate 1 was rejected for a large FORUM.LINVOYAGE.COM watermark, which the other Ao Po marina yacht photos on Commons also carry.

Aerial view in morning light of Wat Phra Nang Sang, the historic temple in Thalang town, with the town and the Khao Phra Thaeo hills behind (Wiki Loves Monuments 2023; found by a Commons search). All three candidates were rejected. c1, the Heroines Monument at night, is a soft, grainy film scan that is mostly black. c2 shows only the museum's roof and lawn, nothing recognisable. c3 is an unrecognisable forest pond and is also the places:bang-pae-waterfall candidate. Commons has no daytime photo of the Heroines Monument.

Long, empty Natai Beach with casuarina trees and surf, geotagged at Natai; grey monsoon-season sky (candidate 1, passed). Candidate 2 (bababeachclub.com) was rejected: a 700x700 generic beach shot with nothing that places it at Natai, and it would likely repeat on the Baba Beach Club hotel card. Commons searches (Natai, Khok Kloi, Phang-nga Panoramio) found no sunnier free photo.
